verifier_flags: name clash: HIGH GROUND (@highground3065, highground3065.com) is a standalone winter live music series in Fitzroy run by Calibre (CLBR), a music management and venue programming agency co-owned by Nathan Farrell, across The Night Cat, The Evelyn and Punters Club, 28 May to 29 Aug 2026 (debut year). It is not a Leaps and Bounds strand: Leaps and Bounds co-presented (with PBS 106.7FM and CLBR) the one-night HIGH GROUND: IN MOTION on 18 Jul 2026 and listed High Ground shows in its 2026 program. The site says 'See you in 2027' and Calibre plans to grow it, so the name will likely recur each winter. Unrelated to the client.
